consumer: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — the engine's mission-completion check that decides whether the find-item/package turn-in mission can be completed; it asks 'does the player satisfy the required item quantity to turn in?'
scope: items reachable for the mission check — the player's crafting_inventory() (carried items PLUS items reachable nearby), not only the character's own on-person carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete — for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM it queries u.crafting_inventory() and returns whether tmp_inv.has_amount(item_id,item_count) (or the has_amount(1)+has_charges fallback) holds; the returned bool is the authority the engine consumes to gate turn-in
divergence: the package item sits on the ground one tile away (within crafting/reach range) but is not worn/wielded/in inventory: mission::is_complete returns true via crafting_inventory(), but an on-person-only re-derivation from avatar.carried_items[] (or a dialogue actor->has_amount over carried items only) returns false — wrong authority exposed by the scope gap
